title: List_of_artificial_intelligence_journals
summary:
The List of artificial intelligence journals is a Wikipedia article cataloging notable peer-reviewed academic journals that publish research in the field of artificial intelligence, including areas such as machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, robotics, and intelligent systems.

Notable journals in this field include Artificial Intelligence, a scientific journal established in 1970 and published by Elsevier with a 2024 Impact Factor of 4.6 and a CiteScore for 2021-2024 of 15.0. The Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research (JAIR) is an open access peer-reviewed journal covering research in all areas of artificial intelligence, established in 1993 as one of the first scientific journals distributed online, ranked 6th among all diamond open-access artificial intelligence subdomain journals with an H-index of 143 as of 2025.

Other journals listed include Adaptive Behavior, Advances in Distributed Computing and Artificial Intelligence Journal, Applied Artificial Intelligence, Computational Intelligence, Electronic Transactions on Artificial Intelligence, IEEE Intelligent Systems, IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, International Journal of Approximate Reasoning, International Journal of Intelligent Information Technologies, Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Consciousness, Nature Machine Intelligence, Neural Networks, Neurocomputing, and Pattern Recognition.

These journals collectively cover the breadth of AI research, from foundational theory and algorithms to applied research in specific domains. Many are published by major academic publishers such as Elsevier, IEEE, and Springer, and they serve as primary venues for disseminating advances in artificial intelligence research.
